summary: nitro-cjs-requirer beacons host identifiers to hardcoded bare-IP endpoint at install and require time
details: The package ships a postinstall script beacon.cjs that POSTs the installer's hostname, install path, current working directory, and Node version to a hardcoded bare IPv4 endpoint (http://185.158.107.175:8787/_ah/dc) over plain HTTP. The same beacon is also invoked from index.js, so it fires again whenever a consumer require()s the package. The main entry is a stub that wraps the beacon call in a try/catch and exports a Proxy returning no-op functions for any property access, meaning the package has no real functionality beyond triggering the beacon while avoiding build-time crashes. The destination is a bare IP unrelated to any documented publisher infrastructure, is not caller-configurable, and matches a dependency-confusion / reconnaissance-shim shape rather than any legitimate telemetry use.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
